intro: Thule's Head is the grisly proof demanded by the Forsaken to confirm the demise of Thule Ravenclaw, commander of the Scourge forces on Fenris Isle. Bringing this macabre trophy back to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher solidifies the Forsaken's hold on Silverpine Forest.

p: Fenris Isle serves as the primary bastion of the Lich King's Scourge within Silverpine Forest. From deep inside Fenris Keep, the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw directs his legions of rot hides and undead minions, directly threatening Forsaken outposts like the Sepulcher. High Executor Hadrec requires absolute certainty that this dark commander has fallen, refusing to accept any testimony short of Thule's severed head. The violent release of dark magic upon Ravenclaw's death was felt across the woods, but his head remains the physical proof Hadrec requires to declare Fenris Isle broken.
